finding.summary: computeFrontierPressure keeps the highest generation in ownerByJob for claimability, but separately retains every nonterminal pin generation in ownerRows and derives active/stale/replaceable counts plus REPLACEABLE_PRESSURE from ownerRows. Historical superseded generations therefore remain counted as current liveness pressure.
code_refs: scripts/compile-frontier-pressure.mjs: ownerRows.push(row) for every snapshot owner
scripts/compile-frontier-pressure.mjs: ownerByJob selects highest generation per job

impact: Historical recovery generations can inflate REPLACEABLE_PRESSURE even after a newer generation is active.
Guide/metabolism role selection can therefore react to false recovery pressure.
The behavior conflicts with EFF004: only the newest authoritative generation for a job should appear active/current; older generations remain history only.

host_execution_boundary.reason: The available runtime cannot obtain a full GitHub repository checkout/archive: local network/DNS is unavailable and the GitHub connector exposes repository files but not a binary source archive. The persisted compiler bytes were inspected at the exact snapshot SHA, but the full live-filesystem CLI execution requirement remains delegated to the already-existing CI-native executor job.

truth_boundary: This evidence identifies a control-plane defect and does not promote product authority, Current, Human Accepted, Served, or production /w.
